random_control_matching: For every measured locked gene, sample one unique background gene from the same cohort-specific mean-expression decile and assign that replacement to every module containing the original gene. This preserves module size, complete gene-to-module incidence, pairwise and higher-order overlap, and gene-reuse multiplicity.
empirical_specificity_test: Two-sided absolute observed family effect versus overlap-preserving matched random-family effects with plus-one correction.
